suggested_claim_revision: ARC2-Global is a compact forward document-space adapter that applies two closed-form tangent corrections to a centered Procrustes map. With 1,024 fitting pairs, it improves aggregate nDCG@10 across four inspected development collections. A prospective TREC-COVID test confirms gains in 11 of 30 declared comparisons against the specified ridge, SimpleLinear and Converter configurations, while its incremental nDCG advantage over Procrustes and LA2M remains unresolved.
what_results_support: Compact frozen affine adapter plus normalization with two closed-form tangent corrections.
Positive fixed1024 DEV macro nDCG versus all five specified configurations.
B2 improvement in11 of30 declared primary comparisons, specifically Converter5/6, ridge4/6, SimpleLinear2/6.
A material transfer boundary: no confirmed Procrustes/LA2M incremental nDCG advantage and negative E5 Recall differences versus Procrustes.
what_results_dont_support: Independent nDCG improvement over Procrustes or LA2M.
Equivalence, noninferiority, universal dominance or an optimal number of tangent steps.
Best use of all paid fitting pairs; original-paper reproduction claims.
A causal mixed-gallery calibration explanation or tested repair.
Physical-cost, isolated-hardware, SLO, real-traffic, ANN or native-reference superiority claims.
missing_evidence: Broader claims would require independent incremental mechanism/geometric-baseline evidence, broader domains/encoders, independent all-paid comparison or deployment measurements; none is required for the narrowed descriptive claim.
No formal integrity audit and no cross-family semantic review.
next_experiments_needed_note: None to state the narrowed result. Further scientific work is optional and requires new user authorization and an immutable protocol. Do not treat partial as automatic authorization for supplementary runs.
routing_action: Finish current B2 report/figures/claim notes, then STOP; manuscript unchanged; no automatic B3/B4.

individual_claims.claim: A compact affine forward map with exactly two closed-form tangent corrections and no neural training.
individual_claims.reason: Source implements a centered raw affine Procrustes expansion followed by two ridge-solved tangent updates; inference applies the final affine coefficient and row normalization. For 384-to-768 dimensions, 385*768 float32 coefficients require 1,182,720 bytes. This is coefficient storage, not total runtime memory or a unique advantage over ridge/Procrustes. Closed-form describes each correction, not a globally optimal angular solution.

individual_claims.claim: Higher aggregate nDCG than all five declared baseline configurations over the locked inspected DEV matrix.
individual_claims.reason: B1c five macro deltas are +0.024325, +0.104055, +0.172100, +0.095653 and +0.161162; all saved family intervals are positive. This remains inspected DEV, not independent validation or all-condition dominance.

individual_claims.claim: Independent TREC-COVID confirms an advantage over the declared external configurations.
individual_claims.reason: 11/30 family contrasts are positive, 19 unresolved, none family-negative. Gains occur versus Converter in 5/6 conditions, ridge in 4/6 and SimpleLinear in 2/6; none versus Procrustes or LA2M.

individual_claims.claim: The incremental nDCG benefit beyond Procrustes transfers independently.
individual_claims.reason: All six B2 point deltas versus Procrustes are negative and all six family intervals cross zero. This demonstrates neither improvement, inferiority at the family criterion, noninferiority nor equivalence.
All six family intervals cross zero, with both positive and negative point deltas.

individual_claims.claim: Two tangent corrections improve retrieval and are necessary or optimal.
individual_claims.reason: DEV B1-M two-minus-one macro delta +0.006924 has family interval [+0.003809,+0.009959]; two-minus-Procrustes is +0.024325. This supports an average DEV contribution, not independent necessity or optimality. B2 contains no one-step arm, and does not confirm incremental improvement over Procrustes.

individual_claims.claim: ARC2 is the best use of every already-paid fitting pair.
individual_claims.reason: B1-P E5 all-paid loses nDCG to Procrustes (-0.044335, family interval [-0.079696,-0.009272]) and LA2M (-0.037474, [-0.070583,-0.003758]); MiniLM versus all-paid ridge is unresolved. MiniLM fixed-anchor also trails every all-paid baseline in the locked cross-regime comparisons.

individual_claims.claim: Mixed-gallery behavior is important and a score-calibration mechanism is established.
individual_claims.reason: B1-G establishes that actual true-vector replacement can reverse pure-proxy ordering; all-paid FiQA/E5 ARC2 changes 0.314908 to 0.291867, versus Procrustes 0.286096 to 0.336202. It does not isolate a unique causal explanation or validate a calibration repair.

individual_claims.claim: Partial ARC2 generally matches or beats keeping the incumbent or completing destination encoding.
individual_claims.reason: All six B2 ARC2 nDCG point means are below Full-Y; four are below Full-X. E5 Full-X exceeds Full-Y, and all three E5 ARC2 points are below both. The two MiniLM point means above Full-X are descriptive comparisons outside the 30-contrast primary family.

B2 has 25 positive, three negative and two unresolved nominal descriptive Recall intervals. All three E5-vs-Procrustes Recall differences are negative; DEV overall Recall versus Procrustes is unresolved.

individual_claims.claim: Physical migration savings, faster isolated GPU execution, SLO/traffic benefits or ANN behavior.
individual_claims.reason: B2 exact cache-based representation comparisons count logical unique destination exposure, not a physically measured partial-deployment cost. Shared-load receipts and endpoint replay establish neither serving performance nor cost savings. No ANN or real-traffic experiment is present.

individual_claims.claim: The recorded B2 sequence completed and independently replayed every endpoint before first final-label opening.
individual_claims.reason: Final QA verifies the locked 184-cell identities, 60 fit groups, pinned sources and ordered recorded events; all rankings sealed 19:56:09 UTC, replay seal completed 20:11:42 UTC, opening receipt 20:12:17 UTC. This is recorded provenance and computational QA, not a formal audit of every possible human access.

decision_rule: Frozen: primary nDCG family interval strictly >0 supports improvement, strictly <0 worse, otherwise unresolved; Recall nominal95% descriptive. No new margin or threshold.
no_postlabel_retuning_or_selection_evide: Recorded sequence and QA consistent; not a formal all-access integrity audit.
